Synthetic Pewter Accountability Act
(invented for tests; not a text the organization published)
SECTION 1. TITLE.
This bill may be cited as the Synthetic Pewter Accountability Act.
SECTION 2. DEFINITIONS.
"Pewter" means an alloy sold in this state under [ENTER RELEVANT CONSUMER PROTECTION STATUTE].
SECTION 3. ENFORCEMENT.
The attorney general may enforce this act.
